Monitor 227940275 (Redis Errors is High) recovered-OK 13:19:35Z (hash 3169429e58035f6a, #alert-system, degraded DD-scan-diff mode). Both standing candidates for this monitor (ki-2026-07-06-runtime-core-redis-cache-timeout-transient-burst, ki-2026-07-07-runtime-core-expiresessiontoken-accountnotfound) formally refuted — 0 ES hits each on their own evidence_query. by-{service} breakdown showed 100% of this fire's Redis command errors on service:nonprod/apps (mobile-relay tier behind method-nativemobile-ui), matching a 2026-07-31 occurrence of the same monitor (hash 43c326afb17cc913) that first flagged nonprod/apps as a distinct source under this monitor ID but couldn't pin the exact mechanism.

This time it's pinned: 6 identical StackExchange.Redis.RedisServerException CROSSSLOT errors ('del in script attempted to access keys that don't hash to the same slot') in a ~450ms burst, traced to Method.Phoenix.Common.Caching.RedisCacheExtended.FlushEndpointWithLuaAsync -> RedisCache.FlushAsync. Historical check: this exact message has 469 hits over the last 6.5 weeks, all nonprod/apps — chronic and mostly sub-threshold.

Score 1 (below actionable_score_threshold 2) — no #triage-results post, logged to docs/actionable/2026-08-14.md. Likely real (if low-urgency) app bug worth a Jira ticket once method-nativemobile-ui repo access is restored (methodcrm-org GH_TOKEN 403 gap blocked pinning the exact call site this cycle). Full writeup: docs/investigations/2026-08-14-3169429e58035f6a.md
